reason: Protect all generated New Word Guide visuals before migrating wordbooks to a shared master vocabulary library.
rules: Wordbook archive or deletion must never delete files under assets/vocabulary-lessons/.
Visual lookup is keyed by the English word and remains reusable from any current or future category wordbook.
Before removing an image, confirm that no item in data/vocabularyLessonVisuals.json references its main image or thumbnail.
The archive branch is the immutable pre-migration recovery point for all code and image assets.
